meta.supersedes: SESSION723_MAINTENANCE_FRAMEWORK.json (extends — this is the operational superset)
meta.purpose: Comprehensive operational trigger registry for the post-700 governance maintenance lane. Codifies every maintenance cadence, trigger threshold, escalation procedure, ownership assignment, and project-to-maintenance transition rule. This is the operational 'what fires when' document — not the framework itself (S723).

governance_guard.known_gap: DL-008 detection uses DL-029-vulnerable regex window scan, NOT Function constructor parse — S724 §operational_readiness.pre_activation_requirements item 1

certified_pool.volatility_warning: Count confirmed 2,182 at S530 T0. S536-S537 added ENHANCED_CASE_BASE certifications (90 case items). Pack-file certified count is the canonical denominator. Any report claiming a different count must cross-check with raw-file grep per AGENTS.md §5.

baseline_files.expansion_note: Originally 13 runtime-critical files (app core 3 + packs 5 + cases 5). Expanded to 15 with addition of may-core.js and may-learner-state.js (S120-S131 May Coaching Layer, added to baselines S530).

maintenance_cadences.description: Five maintenance cadences govern the operational rhythm post-700. Each defines when checks fire, what checks run, who owns them, and escalation conditions.

cadences.name: T0 Entry Protocol

checks.name: 15-File Hash Verification
checks.description: Verify SHA-256 hash of all 15 baseline files against CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1. Use Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256.
checks.fail_action: Halt all agents. Spawn Governance Auditor to run G1-G5 reconciliation. Do not proceed until hash discrepancy root cause is identified and documented.

checks.name: Certified Count Grep
checks.description: Direct raw-file grep for question_state: Certified across all 5 pack files. Must produce a stable count across two consecutive scans.
checks.pass_condition: Count stable across 2+ scans. Current baseline: 2,182 (S530 T0).
checks.fail_action: Log discrepancy. If delta > 5, escalate to Reconciliation Agent. If count decreases, halt all certification work until root cause determined.

checks.name: DL-008 Function Constructor Parse
checks.description: Parse each pack file via Function constructor and count ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty slots. Must NOT use regex window scan (DL-029 vulnerability).
checks.pass_condition: Count matches CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 open DL-008 items (Pack A: 2, Pack C: 55, Pack D: 10, Pack B: 0, Pack E: 0 = 67 total). Any NEW DL-008 item ≥ 1 Certified triggers CRITICAL escalation.
checks.fail_action: If NEW DL-008 on Certified items: suspend all writes, quarantine affected pack, emergency remediation. If discrepancy in count only (same QIDs): log and update CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3.

checks.name: Governance Guard Test Suite
checks.description: Run node scripts/test_governance_guard.js. All 12 tests must pass. This verifies Rule 2 (DL-008 BLOCK), Rule 3 (Registry BLOCK), Rule 5 (30-item cap BLOCK), Rule 1 (question_state WARN), Rule 4 (answer-key WARN).
checks.pass_condition: 20/20 PASS across all governance guard tests
checks.fail_action: Any FAIL: halt all pack writes. Diagnose which rule failed. If Rule 2/3/5 fail → all pack modification blocked until rule passes. If Rule 1/4 warn → log and proceed, flag for REVISION_HISTORY entry at session close.

checks.name: Pack Parse-Count Verification
checks.description: Parse each pack file (Function constructor) and verify exactly 500 QuestionID objects per pack. Must use Function constructor, not brace-matcher (DL-020 vulnerability).
checks.pass_condition: All 5 packs parse at exactly 500 items each
checks.fail_action: Any pack ≠ 500: halt all pack-write agents on that pack. Structural repair required before any further writes to the affected pack. Undamaged packs may proceed.

cadences.escalation: Any T0 check failure halts the session until resolved. No exceptions. The Governance Auditor is the sole authority for clearing T0 blocks.
cadences.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry at session T0 with: (a) all 15 hash comparison results, (b) certified count with raw grep output, (c) DL-008 parse results with QID list if any NEW items found, (d) governance guard test result.

cadences.name: Rapid Pulse Audit
cadences.frequency: Every 5 sessions or cumulative 3 hours of write activity (whichever comes first)
cadences.trigger_event: Session counter mod 5 = 0, OR cumulative write time ≥ 3 hours since last Rapid Pulse

checks.name: Count Stability Check
checks.description: Re-grep certified count, DL-008 count, and QuestionID count for each pack. Compare to values at previous Rapid Pulse.
checks.pass_condition: No unexplained changes. Any drift must be attributable to documented certification waves or remediation batches.
checks.fail_action: Unexplained drift: reprocess via Function constructor. If count still mismatched, escalate to Reconciliation Agent. Do not rely on single-scan results — require count stability across 2+ independent scans (per AGENTS.md §6).

checks.name: DL-008 Re-Verify (Certified Only)
checks.description: Re-run Function constructor DL-008 parse focusing on Certified items only. Count must not increase from T0 baseline.
checks.pass_condition: Zero NEW DL-008 items in Certified pool. Existing open items unchanged in count.
checks.fail_action: Any NEW DL-008 on a Certified item (≥1): CRITICAL escalation. Halt all writes, quarantine affected pack, spawn Remediation Agent for emergency batch (≤30 items, BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker required).

checks.name: CorrectChoice Distribution Scan
checks.description: Compute CC distribution (A/B/C/D %) per pack and per section. Each position must fall within 22-28% range. Scan via Function constructor parse, not regex.
checks.pass_condition: All CC positions within 22-28% in the overall distribution per pack. Section-level drift flagged at MEDIUM but does not halt.
checks.fail_action: Any position outside 22-28%: flag for psychometric review. If ≥2 packs exhibit distribution outside range → escalate to Certification Auditor. Remediation deferred to next scheduled certification wave — NOT an emergency halt.

cadences.escalation: CRITICAL findings (NEW DL-008 or unexplained count regression) halt all writes. MEDIUM findings (CC distribution) log and defer. No writes by any agent without Defect Sweeper clearance after a CRITICAL Rapid Pulse finding.
cadences.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: (a) all count deltas since last Rapid Pulse with explanation, (b) DL-008 re-verify scan results (QID list if any change), (c) CC distribution table per pack.

cadences.name: Deep Audit — Full G1-G5 Reconciliation
cadences.frequency: Every 20 sessions or domain-closure milestone (e.g., completion of Domain E or F certification)
cadences.trigger_event: Session counter mod 20 = 0, OR achievement of a domain-closure milestone as documented in 800-series certification plan

checks.name: G1 — Ledger Integrity
checks.description: Full G1 gate per SESSION31_RECONCILIATION_EXECUTION.md: Certified count (grep) vs. parse-count (Function constructor) vs. MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY count vs. app.js delivery-pool count. All four sources must agree.
checks.pass_condition: All four counts agree within tolerance of 0.
checks.fail_action: Discrepancy > 0: reconstruct from raw grep as authoritative source. Log delta with explanation. If certified count decreased → CRITICAL. If certified count increased unattributed → HIGH (possible certification without REVISION_HISTORY entry).

checks.name: G2 — Defect Inventory Reconciliation
checks.description: Cross-check DEFECT_LIBRARY.md open defect counts against raw file scan. Every OPEN defect entry must have a confirmed QID list in the source file. Every source-file finding must have a DEFECT_LIBRARY entry (per AGENTS.md §12 — No Staged Findings).
checks.pass_condition: Bidirectional match: all DEFECT_LIBRARY open entries confirmed in source files; all source-file structural defects have DEFECT_LIBRARY entries.
checks.fail_action: Unmatched DEFECT_LIBRARY entry (phantom defect): mark Resolved or update QID list. Unmatched source-file finding: assign next available DL-ID, log to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md as Open. This check MUST complete before any session closes.

checks.name: G3 — REVISION_HISTORY Completeness
checks.description: Verify every question_state change since last Deep Audit has a corresponding REVISION_HISTORY.md entry (per AGENTS.md §4). Verify every content change (answer, explanation, distractor) has a REVISION_HISTORY.md entry. Check for batched entries (prohibited).
checks.pass_condition: Zero orphaned changes. 100% pairing rate between pack-file state changes and REVISION_HISTORY entries.
checks.fail_action: Any orphaned change: retroactively create REVISION_HISTORY entry. Flag as governance gap. If ≥3 orphaned changes found → escalate to Session 31 full reconciliation procedure.

checks.name: G4 — Baseline Hash Stability
checks.description: Re-compute SHA-256 of all 15 baseline files. Compare to CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1 stored values. Any drift must be attributable to documented writes in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
checks.pass_condition: All 15 hashes match OR all drifts are attributable to documented certification/remediation sessions.
checks.fail_action: Unattributed hash change on any file: CRITICAL. Halt all agents. Spawn Reconciliation Agent to run G1-G5 with the file's last-known-good backup. Do not proceed until root cause identified.

checks.name: G5 — Delivery Pool Safety Cross-Check
checks.description: Confirm the delivery mechanism filters by question_state === 'Certified'. Cross-reference against known-defective QID list from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md. Flag any defective QID still present in the delivery pool.
checks.pass_condition: Zero defective QIDs in Certified delivery pool. Only Certified items eligible for learner practice sessions (CAQS_v1.0.md §1.7.1).
checks.fail_action: Any defective QID in delivery pool: CRITICAL. Execute pre-delivery safety check. Quarantine the QID. Update DEFECT_MANIFEST if using May coaching layer. Document in REVISION_HISTORY.md.

cadences.parallelization: G1+G2 in one agent, G3+G4+G5 in another (per AGENTS.md §13.4). Gates may be run in parallel but the continue/stop/escalate gate must be sequential.
cadences.escalation: Full governance halt if any G1-G5 gate produces an unattributed discrepancy. The Reconciliation Agent is the sole authority for clearing deep audit blocks. Session 31 runbook decision logic applies: continue if resolved, stop if unresolved, escalate if critical.
cadences.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: (a) G1-G5 gate results (pass/fail + evidence), (b) any drift detected with root cause, (c) before/after counts for all reconciled metrics, (d) any new DEFECT_LIBRARY entries assigned.

cadences.name: Pre-Delivery Safety Check
cadences.frequency: Before any learner-facing deployment (exam session, review mode, practice test)
cadences.trigger_event: Deployment request — human-initiated or scheduled release

checks.name: Certified-Only Pool Verification
checks.description: Confirm the delivery mechanism (app.js + May coaching layer) filters by question_state === 'Certified'. All non-Certified items (Unprocessed, In Audit, Editorial Queue, Archived) must be excluded from the learner delivery pool.
checks.pass_condition: Only Certified items in delivery pool. 0 non-Certified items accessible.
checks.fail_action: Any non-Certified item in pool: BLOCK deployment. Halt all delivery. Spawn Delivery Safety Inspector to audit app.js delivery filter logic.

checks.name: Defective QID Exclusion
checks.description: Cross-reference delivery pool QIDs against DEFECT_LIBRARY.md known-defective QID list. Specifically: DL-008 (Pack A/C/D Certified), DL-030 (resolved but verify), any new OPEN Critical/High defects. Also cross-reference May's DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026.json if coaching layer active.
checks.pass_condition: Zero known-defective QIDs in the delivery pool. All excluded QIDs are confirmed absent from the pool.
checks.fail_action: Any defective QID in pool: BLOCK deployment. Quarantine QID. Flag in defect manifest. Remove from pool before any learner exposure.

checks.name: DL-008 Zero Final Check
checks.description: Final DL-008 scan on Certified delivery pool items only. Must use Function constructor parse (NOT regex window scan — DL-029 vulnerability). Count must be 0 for delivery pool items.
checks.pass_condition: 0 DL-008 items in the Certified items being deployed. This is independent of the open DL-008 items in CURRENT_BASELINES.md — those are known and blocked from delivery. This check verifies the exclusion is working.
checks.fail_action: Any DL-008 in delivery pool: BLOCK deployment. Intervention required before any learner session uses this pool.

cadences.escalation: Any pre-delivery check failure BLOCKs deployment. No exceptions. Deployment cannot proceed until all three checks pass. This is a hard block — not a warning.
cadences.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: (a) deployment date/time, (b) certified pool size, (c) QID list of excluded items with reason, (d) all three check results with pass/fail evidence.

cadences.name: Baseline Refresh
cadences.frequency: After any session that writes to ≥3 baseline files, or after any session that writes to a single pack file with ≥100 item modifications
cadences.trigger_event: Write count threshold: ≥3 baseline files modified, OR ≥100 items modified in a single pack file during one session

checks.name: Full 15-File Hash Recapture
checks.description: Re-compute SHA-256 of all 15 baseline files. Use Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 in PowerShell. Capture size (bytes) and last-modified timestamp alongside hash.
checks.pass_condition: Hash computation completes for all 15 files. Hashes must differ from prior baseline on files that were legitimately written; must match on files that were not modified.
checks.fail_action: Unexpected hash change on an unmodified file: CRITICAL. Treat as unauthorized write. Halt and investigate before publishing new baselines.

checks.name: CURRENT_BASELINES.md Update
checks.description: Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1 with new SHA-256 hashes, sizes, last-modified timestamps, and provenance notes. Update §2 certified pool snapshot if certification changed. Update §5 baseline verification log with new entry.
checks.pass_condition: CURRENT_BASELINES.md updated with complete, accurate baselines. All 15 files listed. All hashes verified by independent recomputation.
checks.fail_action: Incomplete baselines: do not publish. Re-run hash capture. Only publish when all 15 hashes independently confirmed.

checks.name: Backup Verification
checks.description: Confirm timestamped backups exist for every modified file per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md (mandatory — hard rule, no exceptions). Verify backup files have non-zero size.
checks.pass_condition: Backup files exist for all modified files with .bak-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS extension and non-zero size.
checks.fail_action: Missing or zero-byte backup: do not publish new baselines. Restore from prior backup if needed. Investigate backup protocol violation.

cadences.escalation: Unauthorized hash change on unmodified file: CRITICAL. Missing backup: HIGH (protocol violation). Both block baseline publication. Governance Auditor must review before baselines are refreshed.
cadences.documentation_required: CURRENT_BASELINES.md updated with: (a) full 15-file hash table with new values, (b) provenance notes for each changed file referencing the REVISION_HISTORY entry, (c) new baseline verification log entry. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry noting the baseline refresh.

trigger_thresholds.description: Exact numerical thresholds that fire escalations. These codify and extend the S723 Maintenance Framework trigger_thresholds with precise values, prescribed actions, and clearing criteria. Cross-referenced with the sessions that established each threshold.

thresholds.threshold: ≥ 5 change in either direction (increase or decrease) from last confirmed certified count
thresholds.detection: T0 Entry Protocol (T0-CHK-2) or Rapid Pulse (RP-CHK-1)
prescribed_actions: 1. Re-count via two independent methods: raw grep AND Function constructor parse. Both must agree.
2. If decrease: identify which QIDs lost certified status. Check for unauthorized question_state changes.
3. If increase: identify which QIDs gained certified status. Verify each has a REVISION_HISTORY.md entry and CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification record.
4. Spawn Reconciliation Agent to cross-check G1-G2 gates (ledger integrity + defect inventory).
5. If ≥10 delta: escalate to full G1-G5 reconciliation (Deep Audit).
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: delta direction and magnitude, QID list of changed items, verification method cross-check results, root cause determination.

thresholds.threshold: ≥ 1 NEW Certified item with non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice]
thresholds.detection: T0 Entry Protocol (T0-CHK-3) or Rapid Pulse (RP-CHK-2)
prescribed_actions: 1. Halt all writes to the affected pack file immediately. No writes until cleared.
2. Quarantine the affected QID(s): add to May's DEFECT_MANIFEST if coaching layer active. Remove from delivery pool.
3. Spawn Remediation Agent with BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker (per governance-guard Rule 5). Batch size ≤ 30 items.
4. Remediation Agent clears EW[CC] to empty string. Verifies no content loss (ExplanationCorrect independently carries full explanation).
5. Backup-before-write mandatory per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md.
6. Post-remediation: independent verification by separate agent. Two consecutive DL-008 scans must show 0 on remediated items.
7. Re-run governance guard test suite (must return 20/20 PASS).
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: QID list, CorrectChoice for each, EW[CC] before/after, verification scan results, backup filename. DEFECT_LIBRARY.md updated if new pattern discovered.
thresholds.clearance_authority: Governance Auditor (after independent verification agent confirms 0 DL-008 and governance guard 20/20 PASS)

thresholds.threshold: Any governance guard test FAIL (not just 0/20 — any individual test failure)
thresholds.detection: T0 Entry Protocol (T0-CHK-4), or any session that calls scripts/test_governance_guard.js
prescribed_actions: 1. Halt all pack-file write operations. All agents stop file modification immediately.
2. Identify which rule(s) failed: Rule 2 (DL-008 BLOCK), Rule 3 (Registry BLOCK), Rule 5 (30-item cap BLOCK), Rule 1 (question_state WARN), Rule 4 (answer-key WARN).

3. If Rule 2/3/5 (BLOCK level) failed: determine whether the violation is in a source file (real defect) or the guard plugin (false positive). If real defect: remediate per the rule's prescribed procedure. If false positive: log, do not modify guard plugin without separate authorization.
4. If Rule 1/4 (WARN level) fired: log the specific items flagged. Create REVISION_HISTORY entry at session close. Do not block writes for WARN-level rules.
5. Re-run test suite after remediation. Must return 20/20 PASS before writes resume.
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: which rule failed, which items triggered the violation, remediation actions taken, post-remediation test result. If BLOCK-level rule failed: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry may be required.
thresholds.clearance_authority: Governance Auditor (sole authority — no other agent type can clear a governance guard block)

thresholds.threshold: Any pack file parses to ≠ 500 QuestionID objects (Function constructor parse, NOT brace-matcher)
prescribed_actions: 1. Halt all writes to the affected pack file. Other pack files may proceed if their parse-count is 500.
2. Parse via Function constructor (not brace-matcher — DL-020 string-awareness gap).
3. If parse-count < 500: items were lost. Restore from most recent backup. Identify the session that caused the loss (DL-019 concurrent-write pattern).
4. If parse-count > 500: items were duplicated. Identify duplicate QIDs. Restore from backup, then carefully re-apply intended changes.
5. Compare to MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md QID list. Registry is the authoritative QID inventory.
6. Post-repair: backup-before-any-write. Re-parse to confirm exactly 500. Re-hash to confirm hash stability.
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: pack name, parse-count before/after repair, identified root cause (DL-019 overwrite, file corruption, etc.), backup used, final parse-count verification.
thresholds.clearance_authority: Governance Auditor (after independent verification agent confirms parse-count = 500 and hash stable)

thresholds.metric: Unexpected hash change on any baseline file
thresholds.threshold: Any of the 15 baseline file hashes differs from CURRENT_BASELINES.md §1 AND the change is NOT attributable to a documented write in REVISION_HISTORY.md
thresholds.detection: T0 Entry Protocol (T0-CHK-1) or Deep Audit (DA-CHK-4)
prescribed_actions: 1. Halt all agents immediately. No reads or writes until governance sweep completes.
2. Spawn dedicated Governance Auditor agent to run G1-G5 reconciliation (Session 31 runbook).
3. Identify which file(s) changed and the precise hash delta.
4. Run Sync Anomaly Playbook (Session 52): attribute → baseline-diff → classify → adopt-or-quarantine.
5. If app.js hash changed: CRITICAL — the application layer may have unauthorized or corrupt modifications. Compare against last-known-good backup.
6. If pack file hash changed unattributed: compare parse-count, certified count, and QID inventory against backup. Restore from backup if any structural integrity issue found.
7. If May coaching layer files changed unattributed: treat as 100-series runtime dependency incident. May be authorized runtime update; verify with SESSION_STATUS.
8. Document root cause in REVISION_HISTORY.md. Only resume operations after hash discrepancy explained and baselines re-verified.
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: file(s) affected, old hash, new hash, root cause determination, G1-G5 results, resolution. CURRENT_BASELINES.md updated if the change is legitimate.
thresholds.clearance_authority: Governance Auditor + Reconciliation Agent (dual approval required — this is the only trigger requiring two agent types to clear)

thresholds.threshold: Any CorrectChoice position (A, B, C, or D) falls below 22% or above 28% of total in a pack-wide distribution
prescribed_actions: 1. Compute per-pack CC distribution (A/B/C/D %). Also compute per-section distribution for the section(s) driving the imbalance.
2. Flag for psychometric review. Do NOT halt operations — this is MEDIUM, not CRITICAL.
3. If a single section is the outlier: schedule targeted CC re-balancing during the next certification wave for that section.
4. If the imbalance is systemic (all packs biased toward same position): escalate to HIGH. Investigate template rotation pipeline artifacts (DL-012 clone group patterns).
5. Remediation deferred to certification wave — do not autonomously rotate answers. Answer-key changes require CAQS §1.6 verification (governance-guard Rule 4 WARN).
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: per-pack CC distribution table, section-level breakdown if applicable, psychometric review flag, target re-balance date/800-series session.

thresholds.threshold: Previously unknown defect pattern discovered that affects ≥ 3 items and is NOT in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md
thresholds.severity: HIGH (if severity ≥ HIGH on the standard scale) or MEDIUM (if Medium or below)
thresholds.established_by: AGENTS.md §12 (No Staged Findings); DEFECT_LIBRARY.md §Template for New Entries
thresholds.detector: Any agent (anyone can discover a defect)
prescribed_actions: 1. Assign next available DL-ID from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (current max: DL-033).
2. Classify: Structural / Content / Pedagogical. Assign domain, severity, detection method.

3. Document in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md using the standard template: Defect ID, Class, Domain, Severity, Detected By, Status, Question IDs, File, Stem, Issue, Root Cause, Pattern, Detection Rule, Validator/Source, Correction, Regression Test.
4. Set Status: Open.
5. If severity is CRITICAL or HIGH and affects ≥ 1 Certified item: trigger T-002 (DL-008) or equivalent emergency response for the defect class.
6. Log in REVISION_HISTORY.md at session close — do NOT defer (AGENTS.md §12: No Staged Findings).
thresholds.documentation_required: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry (mandatory). REVISION_HISTORY.md entry (mandatory). If Certified items affected: related escalation documentation per T-002.
thresholds.clearance_authority: Defect Sweeper (for structural defects) or Certification Auditor (for content/pedagogical defects)

thresholds.threshold: Any agent reports that a stored CorrectChoice disagrees with independently derived correct answer (CAQS §1.6 Dimension 1 — Correctness)
thresholds.established_by: SESSION723 escalation_conditions; SESSION700 DL-030 finding; CAQS_v1.0.md §2.3 auto-fail rule
thresholds.detection: Certification Auditor (six-dimension verification) or any agent performing independent derivation
prescribed_actions: 1. Halt certification of the affected item immediately.
2. The discovering agent must document: (a) stem text, (b) all choices, (c) independently derived answer with formula/steps, (d) stored CorrectChoice, (e) confidence level.
3. Spawn independent verification agent with BLIND methodology: agent must solve from stem + choices WITHOUT seeing stored CorrectChoice. Independent agent must confirm or refute the finding.
4. If confirmed by independent verification: TIER 1 answer-key audit triggered. The item is a DL-030-class defect.
5. Remediation Agent applies fix: update CorrectChoice, clear EW[new_CC], fill EW[old_CC] with appropriate distractor text. Update ExplanationCorrect if needed.
6. Re-run six-dimension verification (CAQS §1.6) at HIGH confidence before re-certification.
7. Log to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md as DL-030 entry (or new DL-ID if materially different root cause).
thresholds.documentation_required: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry with: QID, stored CC, corrected CC, independent verification result, formula/derivation evidence, remediation applied. DEFECT_LIBRARY.md update (DL-030 entry).
thresholds.clearance_authority: Certification Auditor + Governance Auditor (dual approval — answer-key changes are the highest-sensitivity modification)

escalation_procedures.description: Consolidated escalation pathways for each event type. These prescribe the exact detection-notification-action-documentation-clearance chain. No discretionary deviation permitted.

procedures.detection: T0 Entry Protocol (T0-CHK-3) or Rapid Pulse (RP-CHK-2)
procedures.notification_chain: Discovering agent → Remediation Agent → Governance Auditor → All pack-write agents (halt broadcast)
actions: DISCOVERING AGENT: Log QID, CorrectChoice, EW[CC] content. Halt own writes.
GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: Broadcast halt to all agents. Verify via independent Function constructor parse.
REMEDIATION AGENT: Receive BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker. Apply EW[CC] clear. Batch ≤ 30 items.
INDEPENDENT VERIFIER: Re-scan affected QIDs via two methods. Confirm 0 DL-008.
GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: Re-run governance guard (20/20 required). Clear halt.
documentation: REVISION_HISTORY.md: QID list, CC, EW[CC] before/after, verification scan, backup name
procedures.clearance: Governance Auditor (after independent verification confirms 0 and governance guard 20/20)

procedures.notification_chain: Discovering agent → Defect Sweeper → Governance Auditor
actions: DISCOVERING AGENT: Document scope (QID list, pattern, suspected root cause, severity assessment).
DEFECT SWEEPER: Assign next DL-ID. Write DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry (full template). Validate against existing entries (no duplicate patterns).
GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: If Certified items affected, determine learner-pool impact. If CRITICAL severity + Certified: trigger ESC-001 equivalent response.
RELEASE NOTE: Add to next session's REVISION_HISTORY entry.
documentation: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md: full entry per standard template (Status: Open)
procedures.clearance: Defect Sweeper (for structural) or Certification Auditor (for content/pedagogical)

actions: DISCOVERING AGENT: Re-count via two methods. Confirm delta is real (not scan artifact).
RECONCILIATION AGENT: Execute G1-G2 gates. Identify exactly which QIDs changed state and when.
If decrease not explained by documented archival/uncertification: CRITICAL — unauthorized question_state change.
If increase not explained by documented certification wave: HIGH — unregistered certification.
Document root cause. If root cause cannot be determined → escalate to full G1-G5 (now CRITICAL).
documentation: REVISION_HISTORY.md: delta magnitude, QID list, root cause, G1-G2 results

procedures.detection: Certification Auditor (six-dimension verification, Dimension 1) or any agent
procedures.notification_chain: Discovering agent → Independent Verifier → Certification Auditor → Governance Auditor
actions: DISCOVERING AGENT: Document derivation evidence. Halt certification of affected item.
INDEPENDENT VERIFIER: Blind re-derivation (stem + choices only, stored CC hidden).
CERTIFICATION AUDITOR: If confirmed: TIER 1 answer-key audit triggered. Assign DL-030 (or new DL-ID).
REMEDIATION AGENT: Apply CorrectChoice fix, adjust EW fields, update EC if needed.
CERTIFICATION AUDITOR: Re-run six-dimension verification. Only re-certify at HIGH confidence.
GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: Ensure REVISION_HISTORY and DEFECT_LIBRARY updated. Confirm governance guard 20/20.
documentation: REVISION_HISTORY.md: QID, old/new CC, blind verification result, derivation evidence
DEFECT_LIBRARY.md: DL-030 entry (or new DL-ID). If DL-030: update existing entry with new QID.

procedures.notification_chain: Discovering agent → Governance Auditor → All agents (halt broadcast)
actions: GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: Halt all agents. Identify changed file(s).
Run Sync Anomaly Playbook (Session 52): attribute → baseline-diff → classify → adopt-or-quarantine.
If app.js: compare to last-known-good backup. Restore if unauthorized.
If pack file: parse-count check. Compare to backup. Restore if structural issue.
If May layer: verify with SESSION_STATUS or 100-series. May be authorized runtime update.
RECONCILIATION AGENT: Full G1-G5 reconciliation.
Document root cause. Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md after resolution.
documentation: REVISION_HISTORY.md: file(s), old/new hash, root cause, G1-G5 results
procedures.clearance: Governance Auditor + Reconciliation Agent (dual — the only dual-clearance escalation)

procedures.detection: T0 Entry (T0-CHK-4) or any session running test_governance_guard.js
procedures.notification_chain: Discovering agent → Governance Auditor → All agents (halt broadcast)
actions: GOVERNANCE AUDITOR: Halt all pack-file writes. Identify violated rule.
Rule 2 violation: treat as ESC-001 (DL-008 re-emergence).
Rule 3 violation: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md was hand-edited (prohibited). Rebuild from source files.
Rule 5 violation: batch size exceeded 30 items. Split batch and add BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker.
After remediation: re-run governance guard. Must return 20/20 PASS.
Investigate whether the violation was real (file defect) or false positive (guard bug). If guard bug: log but do NOT modify guard without authorization.
documentation: REVISION_HISTORY.md: violated rule, items triggering violation, remediation, post-fix test result

ownership_assignments.description: Every trigger, cadence, and escalation pathway is assigned to a named maintenance agent type. These assignments are non-discretionary — the named owner is the operational authority for that domain.

governance_auditor.label: Governance Auditor
governance_auditor.authority: Highest operational authority in maintenance mode. Sole clearance for T0 blocks, governance guard blocks, and baseline hash disputes.
governance_auditor.mode: Read-only except for CURRENT_BASELINES.md writes and REVISION_HISTORY.md entries
owned_triggers: T-005 (unexpected hash change — co-owner with Reconciliation Agent)
governance_auditor.required_at: Every session T0, every governance guard failure, every unexpected hash change
governance_auditor.skills: Hash verification, Function constructor parsing, governance guard diagnosis, G1-G5 coordination

reconciliation_agent.label: Reconciliation Agent
reconciliation_agent.authority: Owns G1-G5 reconciliation gates. Sole authority to clear count discrepancies and ledger integrity issues.
reconciliation_agent.mode: Read-only (reports drift, does not fix — routes findings to Remediation Agent)
owned_triggers: T-005 (unexpected hash change — co-owner with Governance Auditor)
reconciliation_agent.required_at: Every 20 sessions, every count discrepancy ≥ 5, every domain-closure milestone
reconciliation_agent.skills: G1-G5 runbook execution, count reconciliation, REVISION_HISTORY audit, DEFECT_LIBRARY cross-reference

defect_sweeper.label: Defect Sweeper
defect_sweeper.authority: Owns structural defect discovery and classification. Assigns DL-IDs. Performs DL-008/026/013/031 scans.
defect_sweeper.mode: Read-only (scans and flags — does not remediate)
owned_triggers: T-007 (new defect class — primary classification authority)
defect_sweeper.required_at: Every 5 sessions or 3h writes, every new defect discovery
defect_sweeper.skills: DL-008/026/013/031 scanning, DEFECT_LIBRARY.md authoring, CC distribution analysis, pattern classification

certification_auditor.label: Certification Auditor
certification_auditor.authority: Owns CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification. Sole authority to certify items and approve answer-key changes.
certification_auditor.mode: Read-only (verifies — does not modify answer keys directly)
owned_triggers: T-006 (CC distribution — co-owner with Defect Sweeper)
T-008 (answer-key integrity — co-owner with Governance Auditor)
certification_auditor.required_at: Every certification wave (800-series), every answer-key integrity report, every psychometric review flag
certification_auditor.skills: CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification, independent derivation, blind verification methodology, difficulty calibration, Bloom's taxonomy assessment

baseline_maintainer.label: Baseline Maintainer
baseline_maintainer.authority: Owns CURRENT_BASELINES.md. Sole authority to update hash baselines after verified writes.
baseline_maintainer.mode: Write (CURRENT_BASELINES.md only — backup required before every write)
baseline_maintainer.required_at: After ≥3-file write sessions, after any session with ≥100 item modifications in a single pack
baseline_maintainer.skills: SHA-256 computation, CURRENT_BASELINES.md format compliance, backup protocol, provenance documentation

delivery_safety_inspector.label: Delivery Safety Inspector
delivery_safety_inspector.authority: Owns pre-delivery safety checks. Sole authority to BLOCK learner-facing deployment.
delivery_safety_inspector.mode: Read-only (verifies delivery pool — does not modify pools directly)
delivery_safety_inspector.skills: Delivery pool verification, defective QID cross-reference, DEFECT_MANIFEST integration, app.js delivery filter audit

remediation_agent.label: Remediation Agent
remediation_agent.authority: Sole authority to modify pack files. All writes must be BLOCK-AUTHORIZED and batch-capped at ≤30 items (governance-guard Rule 5).
remediation_agent.mode: Write (pack files only — backup required before every write per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md)
owned_triggers: T-002 (DL-008 — executor, receives authorization from Governance Auditor)
T-008 (answer-key fix — executor, receives authorization from Certification Auditor)
remediation_agent.required_at: Every DL-008 remediation, every answer-key correction, every DL-026/025 remediation, every structural repair
remediation_agent.skills: EW[CC] clear operations, distractor explanation authoring, backup protocol, batch-cap compliance, post-remediation verification

transition_notes.description: The transition from project-phase governance (active development, Sessions 1-700) to maintenance-phase governance (stability preservation, Sessions 700+) requires adjusted cadences, tighter thresholds, and a different operational posture. This section documents the specific differences.

project_phase.label: Project-Phase Governance (Sessions 1-700)
project_phase.era: Active development — frequent writes, new content creation, certification waves, defect remediation, structural changes

characteristics.write_frequency: High — multiple writes per session, often to multiple packs
characteristics.governance: Build-time: governance-guard.js active. Runtime governance (Session 53) for long sessions. G1-G5 reconciliation per milestone.
characteristics.change_velocity: ~100-500 item modifications per active session during peak development
characteristics.risk_tolerance: Moderate — defects expected, rapid remediation model
characteristics.agent_cadence: Sessions could operate with ad-hoc checks. T0 protocol not enforced at every start.

thresholds_then.t0_entry: Recommended, not mandated. AGENTS.md §9 made it a startup protocol but enforcement was per-session.
thresholds_then.deep_audit: Per milestone, not per session count. Session 31 defined the G1-G5 runbook.
thresholds_then.baseline_refresh: Ad-hoc — CURRENT_BASELINES.md created at Session 20, updated sporadically during active development.
thresholds_then.change_batching: No hard cap early in project. 30-item cap (governance-guard Rule 5) added during defect remediation phase.

maintenance_phase.label: Maintenance-Phase Governance (Session 700+)
maintenance_phase.era: Stability preservation — infrequent writes, certification pipeline only, no new content creation, defect remediation via 800-series

characteristics.write_frequency: Low — writes only during 800-series certification waves or emergency remediation (T-002/Critical events)
characteristics.certified_pool_growth: Slow — from 2,182 to eventual 2,500 (87.3% → 100%). Growth only through 800-series certification.
characteristics.governance: Full maintenance cadence regime: M1-M5 operational at all times. Every session starts at T0. Governance guard always validated.
characteristics.change_velocity: Near-zero outside of scheduled certification windows. 800-series batches are planned, not discovered.
characteristics.risk_tolerance: Zero tolerance for regression. Any Certified item defect is CRITICAL. Any new DL-008 is a halt.
characteristics.agent_cadence: All sessions follow the T0 → [task] → Tend protocol. No ad-hoc operations.

t0_entry.change: MANDATORY — no session starts without full T0 protocol completion.
t0_entry.rationale: In project phase, writes were frequent and defects were expected. In maintenance, any unattributed file change is a CRITICAL anomaly.
t0_entry.enforcement: Governance Auditor blocks session start if any T0 check fails.

rapid_pulse.change: NEW in maintenance phase. Did not exist in project phase.
rapid_pulse.rationale: In project phase, frequent writes meant drift was continuously visible. In maintenance, long write-free intervals could mask accumulated drift.
rapid_pulse.enforcement: Defect Sweeper triggers at session counter mod 5 or 3h cumulative writes.

deep_audit.change: Frequency reduced from 'per milestone' to 'every 20 sessions or domain closure'.
deep_audit.rationale: In project phase, milestones arrived frequently (sub-batch certification, defect sweeps, etc.). In maintenance, certification milestones are fewer and farther apart.
deep_audit.enforcement: Reconciliation Agent triggered at session count mod 20 or 800-series domain closure.

pre_delivery.change: NEW mandatory gate. Project phase did not have a formal pre-delivery check.
pre_delivery.rationale: In project phase, the pool was being built — deploying uncertified items was the default. In maintenance, the pool is 87.3% certified and growing — every deployment must be defect-free.
pre_delivery.enforcement: Delivery Safety Inspector BLOCKs deployment if any check fails. No exception.

baseline_refresh.change: Tighter trigger: was ad-hoc, now mandatory after ≥3-file writes.
baseline_refresh.rationale: In maintenance, writes are rare and significant. Every write session that touches multiple files must be captured in baselines immediately.
baseline_refresh.enforcement: Baseline Maintainer triggered after any ≥3-file write session.

certified_count_threshold.change: Threshold tightened from implicit to explicit ≥5 delta.
certified_count_threshold.rationale: With 2,182 items certified, a delta of 1-4 could be a scan artifact or meta-only change. ≥5 indicates a real certification or regression event.

dl008_threshold.change: Zero tolerance: ≥ 1 NEW on Certified = halt. In project phase: ≥ 1 flagged, batch remediated.
dl008_threshold.rationale: In project phase, DL-008 was a known development artifact — 539 were identified and remediated. In maintenance, any NEW DL-008 on a Certified item means regression occurred. Immediate halt, no exceptions.

change_authorization.change: All maintenance-phase pack-file writes require BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker (governance-guard Rule 5). In project phase: marker recommended but not always enforced.
change_authorization.rationale: Maintenance writes are scheduled, planned, and batched. Unauthorized writes are anomalies.

ownership_gaps_from_s724.note: S724 identified 6 post-700 ownership gaps. These do not block maintenance mode activation (score 23/25) but must be addressed in the maintenance lane.

gaps.recommendation: Assign to 100-series as runtime dependency. Governance Auditor verifies May layer hash at T0.
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — May layer is a runtime dependency. If it changes unattributed, app.js behavior may change without governance visibility.

gaps.recommendation: S310 (Portfolio Operations Dashboard) must execute. 300-series closure should be a maintenance milestone tracked by Reconciliation Agent.
gaps.risk: LOW — 300-series is read-only analytics. No impact on learner safety. But incomplete series creates governance debt.

gaps.description: No G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 enforcement in certification pipeline
gaps.recommendation: Certification Auditor must enforce G-NEW rules (QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4) during every 800-series certification wave.
gaps.risk: HIGH — G-NEW-1 (dual-block source-of-truth), G-NEW-2 (topic mismatch), G-NEW-3 (scan methodology), G-NEW-4 (case explanation sufficiency) were established after DL-008/DL-016/DL-029 discoveries. Without enforcement, items certified post-700 may repeat these defect patterns.

gaps.description: Governance guard DL-008 detection still uses DL-029-vulnerable regex window scan
gaps.recommendation: Upgrade governance guard Rule 2 to use Function constructor parse for DL-008 detection. Critical: the current guard may produce false positives (Pack B pattern) or false negatives (DL-020 brace-matcher undercount).
gaps.risk: HIGH — the governance guard is the BLOCK-level enforcement for DL-008. If its detection is unreliable, the primary learner-safety defense is compromised.

gaps.description: CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 reports stale DL-008 phantom items (67 items may not match reality)
gaps.recommendation: Re-verify DL-008 counts via Function constructor parse. Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 to match actual verified counts.
gaps.risk: HIGH — baselines that claim 67 open DL-008 when actual count differs undermine all certified-count verification and T0 checks.

gaps.recommendation: Create scripts/t0_baseline_verify.js: automated 5-minute T0 protocol executor that runs all 5 checks, outputs pass/fail, and captures evidence. Recommended by S724 §operational_readiness.pre_activation_requirements.
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — T0 is currently manual (5-10 min of agent commands). Without automation, human error or protocol drift is possible.

operational_readiness.score_explanation: Framework in place. Cadences defined. Triggers documented. Owners assigned. Two documentation gaps (governance guard upgrade, CURRENT_BASELINES.md correction) prevent 25/25.

pre_activation_requirements_from_s724.requirement: Fix governance guard DL-008 detection to use Function constructor parse
Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 to remove phantom DL-008 items
Create scripts/t0_baseline_verify.js for automated T0 protocol
